item: Frozen fixture GGUF: one 0.5B-1.5B instruct model file
why: L2-2, L2-3 and L2-4 load it from a read-only path. Too large for the repo: it lives in read-only eval storage and only its SHA-256 is recorded (calibration.md). To stay neutral it must use a widely supported architecture and a common quantization so any GGUF-native server can load it, carry its chat template in the file, and have an open license that allows storing and running it. Suggested pick: the first candidate (largest size allowed, so the 5% disk margin is about 55 MB rather than about 20 MB, and published by the model's own authors).

candidates.pin: repository commit hash + the file's SHA-256 (LFS sha256 on the file page); check with gguf_info.py and record both in calibration.md

candidates.size: about 0.4-0.5 GB (confirm on the file page)

item: Read-only storage for the model file inside the sandbox
why: The item mounts the GGUF read-only at a path. The file is uploaded once and mounted read-only in every q13 sandbox (both groups); a write to the mount must fail.

candidates.source: a Modal Volume in the eval's own Modal workspace, mounted read-only at /models
